items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember once Crouch, Sandler Crouch was talking with me

ctx.x: And he had a different side too that I didn't want to experience. I remember once Crouch, Sandler Crouch was talking with me, and he said "If you had gone with Miles, that wouldn't have worked." I said "Why is that?" He said "Cause when the women come around, he would get upset."
